definitions.gloss: far right; extreme right wing (in politics)
definitions.explanation: A political label for the extreme right end of the ideological spectrum — parties, groups, or individuals associated with strong nationalism, anti-immigration positions, or hardline conservatism. Used in news reporting, commentary, and academic writing about politics worldwide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{極右|きょくう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧だ。
⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{極右|きょくう}⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばした→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: A far-right party gained votes in the election.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧、{極右|きょくう}⟦{勢力|せいりょく}→勢力：11812_seiryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台頭|たいとう}→台頭：07595_taitou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In Europe there has been growing concern in recent years about the rise of far-right forces.

notes:
Literally "extreme right," from ⟦{極|きょく}→極：13150_kyoku⟧ (extreme, pole) and {右|う} (right). The word is neutral in form but almost always critical in context — speakers who use it are typically distancing themselves from the groups they describe. In Japanese political discourse it is sometimes also used for hardline nationalist or street-activist groups.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {極右|きょくう}⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧: far-right political party
- {極右|きょくう}⟦{勢力|せいりょく}→勢力：11812_seiryoku⟧: far-right forces
- {極右|きょくう}⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧: far-right ideology
- {極右|きょくう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台頭|たいとう}→台頭：07595_taitou⟧: the rise of the far right
- {極右|きょくう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to be called far-right

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{極左|きょくさ}→極左：23933_kyokusa⟧: far left — direct antonym
- ⟦{右翼|うよく}→右翼：12071_uyoku⟧: right wing — broader term covering the full right of the spectrum
- ⟦{保守|ほしゅ}→保守：19090_hoshu⟧: conservative — the mainstream right
- ネオナチ: neo-Nazi — a specific variety of far-right group
